narr: A potent shortwave trough was ejecting into the southern Great Plains by evening. This resulted in the development of a broken line of strong to severe thunderstorms from the Stockton Plateau to the Permian Basin. Several severe wind reports, localized wind damage, and flash flooding were reported with a few of these thunderstorms.
ev: Flooding was reported in a lower water crossing with two high-water rescues.
lsr: Flooding in low water crossing and two high water rescues.
